app.name: VinaWrite
app.description: Optimize and translate your messages with AI.
app.optionsDescription: Select text or click into any text box, then use the floating toolbar.
options.subtitle: AI writing & translation settings
options.saveFailed: Unable to save settings. Please try again.
context.title: Conversation context
context.description: Reads recent messages on Slack, Discord, and MS Teams so results match who you are talking to.
tone.title: Default writing style
tone.description: Choose the default writing style used when optimizing selected text or using the quick shortcut. You can still switch styles from the popup menu at any time.
tone.placeholder: Add instructions for this writing style, such as audience, voice, or terminology preferences.
tone.saved: This instruction is appended only for the selected style and is saved with the other settings.
content.loadBaseUrl: Load models from the configured Base URL.
content.unableLoadModels: Unable to load the model list.
content.translationDisclaimer: VinaWrite translations are based on web content and context.
provider.heroTitle: Choose how VinaWrite writes for you
provider.heroDescription: Connect a provider, keep your keys organized, and tune the model that powers every writing action.
provider.geminiDescription: Google AI Studio API key with a generous free quota and fast Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite support.
provider.customDescription: Connect to DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, or local models through Ollama.
api.getToken: Get a free key from Google AI Studio
api.rotateDescription: Moves to the next backup key when a key runs out of quota or is rejected.
api.connectionSuccess: Connection successful! The API key is working.
api.missingKey: Add at least one API key to test.
sites.title: Hidden sites
sites.description: The floating toolbar stays hidden on these sites. The context menu still works.
sites.empty: No hidden sites yet. Use the hide button on the floating toolbar to add one.
custom.title: Custom provider (OpenAI-compatible)
custom.help: Works with any OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint. VinaWrite calls /chat/completions and sends your key as a bearer token, if you set one.
custom.connectionSuccess: Connection successful! The LLM provider responded.
standalone.title: VinaWrite - Standalone Testbed
standalone.subtitle: Live playground and E2E testing environment
standalone.tryExtraction: Try chat extraction (Slack/Discord) and automatic replacement.
standalone.tip: Tip: Configure an API key in the Settings tab to call AI directly!
standalone.sarahMessage: Hi team, please review the PRD for the upcoming release.

standalone.alexMessage: The Uiverse Galaxy components look clean. Please proceed.
model.title: AI model
model.flashLiteDescription: Ultra-low latency, quota efficient, and instant responses for chat and translation.
model.flashDescription: Deep contextual reasoning, vocabulary lookup, and precise wording.
model.stableDescription: A lightweight, stable model for everyday emails and messages.
model.standardDescription: A standard model generation with high reliability and consistency.
tone.translateDescription: Two-way translation with grammar and vocabulary
outputLanguage.title: Output language per mode
outputLanguage.description: Results of each mode are written in the language you choose here. You can also change it right in the popup.
